desc:
⛵ INCREMENTAL PIECE ⛵

A text-based incremental game inspired by One Piece

Like the game & join the group to use codes!

Train, fight & rise from rookie pirate to legend.

🎲 ROLL YOUR DESTINY
Use Scrolls to roll your Haki, Clan & Race — each comes with different rarities, boosts and abilities.

🌀 SUMMON POWER
Unlock Weapons, Gear & Devil Fruits through the summoning system. Build a strong loadout and evolve your build.

📖 10 STORY ARCS
Progress through 10 arcs, face stronger enemies, defeat bosses and push deeper into the world.

♻️ REBIRTH
Reset your progress for permanent multipliers, bonus rolls and faster scaling. Each run gets stronger.

⚔️ BUILD YOUR STRENGTH
Train, fight and stack upgrades to increase damage, speed and earnings.

🎁 RARE DROPS & PROGRESSION
Earn scrolls, unlock higher tiers and chase rare rolls to dominate each arc.

⛵ADVENTURE
Search for rare loot, Gems & rolls. Upgrade your tools to search faster & find rarer items.

⭐ Favorite so you don’t miss updates!
